Subject: RetailEdge AWS Marketplace - phased TCV credit request and listing timing

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation and clear technical fit. Per our call you asked whether we can structure the AWS Marketplace private offer with a phased committed TCV and an upfront marketplace listing credit to help with procurement timing. I took a first pass at what would make the easiest path for both teams: 

- Phase 1 (Q3): 12-month pilot, $120k committed TCV, 30% marketplace listing credit applied to first invoice to offset procurement setup costs.
- Phase 2 (Q4+): Expand to full product suite, 24-month commit, remaining credits pro-rated into the second-year billing.

Attached is the revised SOW and a draft PO template that matches our marketplace billing flow. Before I send this through procurement internally I need to request an exception/approval from Deal Desk for the one-time listing credit (30% on the pilot TCV) and to confirm that AWS co-sell incentives won't be impacted. Can you confirm: 1) target listing date you need on the AWS catalog, and 2) if Procurement requires a single PO or can accept staged PO entries tied to phases?

Happy to hop on a quick call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Naomi

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the clear breakdown — this looks promising. A couple of quick answers: 

- Target listing date: wed like the listing live by 15 Sep 2027 to coincide with our vendor showcase.
- Procurement: they prefer a single PO if possible, but will accept staged POs if each phase is explicitly called out and ticketed. Ill ask them for a short confirmation note and add them to threads.

Two asks from our side: can the marketplace listing credit be structured as an upfront discount on the marketplace invoice (so our accounting team doesnt treat it as a rebate), and can you confirm whether AWS co-sell eligibility is preserved if we record the initial 12-month pilot as the committed term?

Sam

Team — forwarding RetailEdge thread. RetailEdge (SAM & Procurement) are asking for a 30% one-time listing credit applied up front against the pilot invoice and to confirm AWS co-sell eligibility for a 12-month committed pilot. They want listing live by 15 Sep.

Quick context: pipeline motion is an initial $120k pilot (12 months) leading into a larger 24-month expansion. PoC must be in the marketplace to meet buyer's procurement timeline. We typically reserve the listing credit for strategic early-publisher cases; I'm requesting an exception because the account is high-velocity and we have co-sell motion with their AWS AM.

Specific approvals I need:
- Approve one-time 30% listing credit on pilot invoice (would be booked as a marketplace discount).
- Confirm AWS co-sell eligibility will remain intact if we record pilot as 12-month commit.
- Approve target listing date 15 Sep and pledge from Marketplace Ops to prioritize the SKU provisioning (I will coordinate).

Notes: Deal economics post-credit still meet our acquisition thresholds (see attached SOW for ARR math). Im happy to join any quick deal desk call.

Thanks,
Naomi

Naomi / team — thanks for the details and for flagging the timeline. Im supportive of approving a one-time marketplace listing credit at 30% on the pilot invoice given the high probability of expansion and explicit AWS co-sell involvement. Conditions and notes: 

1) Structure: Credit to be processed as an upfront Marketplace invoice discount (accounting-friendly) — Marketplace Ops to reflect as discounted unit price on first invoice.
2) AWS co-sell: Confirm with AWS AM that this structure does not disqualify co-sell incentives; we will require written confirmation from the AWS AM before finalizing the private offer. I will loop in our partner lead if needed.

4) Approval: Approved subject to AWS AM confirmation and Ops sign-off on provisioning timeline.

Naomi — please request written verification from their AWS AM and share Procurement's PO preference (single vs staged) so we can finalize billing flow.
